title: ExchangeTote: exchange a specific tote using ToteName
summary: Use the OptiSweep/WCS API function ExchangeTote with the required parameter ToteName to exchange the specific tote identified by that ToteName.
when_to_use: When you need to exchange a specific tote and the API call requires ToteName to target that exact tote.
roles_and_responsibilities: L1_support: Execute the ExchangeTote API call with the correct ToteName and confirm the exchange targets the intended tote.
access_or_tools_needed: OptiSweep/WCS API access (as implied by the source listing of tote-related APIs) via API Dog

access_required: OptiSweep/WCS API access (API Dog / API access on the primary servers as described in the source)

steps.title: Prepare the ToteName for the tote you want to exchange
steps.purpose: ExchangeTote requires ToteName to target the specific tote to exchange.
steps.instruction: Identify the ToteName value corresponding to the specific tote you intend to exchange, so you can supply it as the ToteName parameter to ExchangeTote.
steps.expected_result: You have a ToteName value ready to use as the ExchangeTote request parameter.
steps.healthy_condition: The ToteName you plan to use corresponds to the tote you intend to exchange (i.e., you are not guessing or using an unrelated tote identifier).
steps.failure_condition: You do not have the correct ToteName for the intended tote, or you are uncertain which tote the ToteName refers to.

actions.label: Confirm ToteName to target the intended tote
actions.exact_action: Confirm the ToteName value for the tote you want to exchange.

steps.title: Call ExchangeTote with the ToteName
steps.purpose: Trigger the tote exchange for the specific tote identified by ToteName.
steps.instruction: Using the OptiSweep/WCS API tooling (API Dog as referenced by the source), call ExchangeTote and set the required request parameter ToteName to the value prepared in the previous step.
steps.expected_result: The ExchangeTote request is issued with ToteName as the required parameter.
steps.healthy_condition: The ExchangeTote call includes ToteName (the required parameter) and is targeted to the intended tote identifier.
steps.failure_condition: The ExchangeTote call is missing ToteName or uses an incorrect ToteName value.

steps.title: Verify the exchange targets the specific tote identified by ToteName
steps.purpose: Ensure the exchange performed corresponds to the tote specified by ToteName.
steps.instruction: After the ExchangeTote call, verify that the exchange result corresponds to the specific tote identified by the ToteName you provided (i.e., the exchange is for that specific tote).
steps.expected_result: The specified tote (by ToteName) is exchanged.
steps.healthy_condition: The exchange outcome aligns with the ToteName you supplied (the intended tote is the one exchanged).
steps.failure_condition: The wrong tote is exchanged or no exchange occurs for the intended tote.

actions.label: Check that the exchange is for the intended ToteName
actions.exact_action: Verify the exchange targets the specific tote identified by ToteName.

stop_or_escalate_if: If the wrong tote is exchanged or no exchange occurs, verify the ToteName and escalate if still incorrect.

healthy_conditions: ExchangeTote targets the specific tote identified by ToteName (not a different tote).
failure_conditions: No exchange occurs for the intended tote.
